                                                                   EXHIBIT 99.2

                         CONSENT TO BE NAMED DIRECTOR OF
                            NEW CERIDIAN CORPORATION


         The undersigned does hereby consent to being appointed or continuing to
serve as a director of New Ceridian Corporation, a Delaware corporation (the
"New Ceridian"), in connection with the spin-off of New Ceridian by Ceridian
Corporation. The undersigned further consents to being named as a director of
New Ceridian in any filing made by New Ceridian or any of its affiliates with
the Securities and Exchange Commission in connection with the spin-off and
agrees to serve as a director of New Ceridian for the term provided in the
by-laws of New Ceridian.


Dated:  September 8, 2000
                                                  /s/ Bruce R. Bond
                                                  -----------------------------
                                                  Bruce R. Bond
